newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Norilsk Nickel to use new share registry.
newsitem.headline: Norilsk Nickel to use new share registry.

text.p: Russia's RAO Norilsky Nikel will transfer its share registry to the National Registration Company from Unikombank, making it the registrar's biggest client, its major shareholder Uneximbank said on Monday.

Norilsk Nickel is the biggest Russian company to join the National Registration Company, which was set up last year, but only started active business in April, its marketing manager Alexander Gorlov told Reuters.
It now has 12 clients, including St Petersburg Telephone, optical goods maker Leningradskoye Optiko-Mekhanicheskoye Obyedineniye (LOMO) and Novorossiisk Shipping Company, he said.

The registrar was founded by the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, the World Bank's private-sector affiliate the International Finance Corporation, Bank of New York Stock Registry Corp, Uneximbank and NIKoil, a registrar for LUKoil oil group.
LUKoil itself has not yet transferred its shares to the National Registration Company.
